optional_paced_profile.name: fpga-next-selected-v2-dma-lines-owners4-yield4
optional_paced_profile.tradeoff: Lower worst latency in the tested dirty 4 KiB read/write cases; lower isolated throughput and slower cold 128 KiB write makespan. No universal fairness improvement.

qualification_scope: Cloud source candidate. Tested owner/yield pairs: 1/0, 2/0, 4/0, 4/4, 4/16. Yield16 is measured but not selected. Native PPA, timing, CDC and board performance are pending.
